title: Missing historical plate record must not default to J2016 coordinates in vanishing channel
what_happened: During live single-star inspection of high-proper-motion halo dwarf Gaia DR3 5628404318169472 (v_tan=114.6 km/s) with empty vanishing_data, VanishingChannel.measure defaulted usno_ra_deg/usno_dec_deg to J2016 Gaia coordinates and early_plates_count to 2 while back-propagating proper motion to 1953.4, producing a synthetic 6.53 arcsec mismatch and false vanishing trigger.
generic_lesson: Channels comparing multi-epoch catalogs must never substitute modern coordinates for absent historical epoch measurements or assume non-zero plate counts when archival plate data are missing.
